# AIS-IO-01

**Is every model that receives untrusted input identified, with its untrusted inputs named?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | IO: Inputs and outputs |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.ai.input_trust`, `connectors.carries_untrusted_content` |

## Rule

Every ai facet has input_trust; an element receiving a connector that carries untrusted content does not declare input_trust trusted.

## Sources

- OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026, LLM01 Prompt Injection (`owasp-llm01`)
